'''Varak'Cha''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] loan shark who resided in [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] around the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] bartender [[Robb]] owed him a large amount of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
